programme.desc: In a career that stretches back to the mid-seventies, Thorogood and his band have released 16 albums with worldwide sales in excess of 15 million. 2013 saw George & The Destroyers make their long overdue debut at the legendary Montreux Jazz Festival.

programme.title: Bruce Springsteen: Live in Hyde Park
programme.desc: "London Calling: Live in Hyde Park" is a concert video of Bruce Springsteen & the E Street Band's performance during the Hard Rock Calling music festival in Hyde Park, London on June 28, 2009.

programme.title: Foo Fighters - Austin City Limits
programme.desc: The Austin City Limits Music Festival is an annual music festival that takes place at Zilker Park in Austin, Texas. The festival features more than 130 bands on eight stages for three days.

programme.title: Qello Concerts' Best
programme.desc: The best of Qello Concerts.

programme.title: AC/DC - Circus Krone
programme.desc: Filmed at the Circus Krone in Munich, this concert features performances of "Rock N Roll Damnation" and "What's Next to the Moon" and more.

programme.title: Tom Petty & The Heartbreakers - Live at Soundstage
programme.desc: Filmed live from the Vic Theatre, Chicago, Illinois, USA in April 2003 for the 'Soundstage' TV series.

programme.title: Duane Allman - Song of the South
programme.desc: Duane Allman, the lead guitarist and driving force behind Southern Rock pioneers The Allman Brothers Band, lived a tragically short life, but during his brief career he changed music forever.

programme.title: The Beach Boys - Good Vibrations Tour
programme.desc: The Beach Boys Special is a rockumentary which explores the life of the Beach Boys as camera and crews follow them across the United States on their Good Vibrations Tour.

programme.title: Ellie Goulding -- Live at the iTunes Festival
programme.desc: Since releasing her first album in 2010, Ellie has traveled the world to showcase her talents, both in the voice and in the composition of her songs.

programme.title: Journey - Live in Manila
programme.desc: On March 14, 2009, Journey returned to Arnel Pineda's homeland and introduced him as their newest lead singer to a crowd of nearly 30,000 at the SM Mall of Asia Concert Grounds. Features songs such as Don't Stop Believin', Stone In Love, When You Love A Woman and Separate Ways.

programme.title: J Balvin - Bruuttal
programme.desc: J. Balvin returns to his hometown of Medellín, Colombia to perform a special anniversary concert entitled BRUUTTAL. A musical journey that begins with his early songs and ends with his most recent, multi-platinum album, Energía.

programme.title: Bob Marley: Uprising Live !
programme.desc: This live show from Dortmund's Westfalenhalle was filmed on June 13th 1980, featuring Bob Marley on superb form. Marley's energetic, charismatic performance includes I Shot The Sheriff, Get Up, Stand Up and No Woman, No Cry and the film has been substantially restored to a high level.

programme.title: Foo Fighters - Austin City Limits
programme.desc: The Austin City Limits Music Festival is an annual music festival that takes place at Zilker Park in Austin, Texas. The festival features more than 130 bands on eight stages for three days.

programme.title: Metallica - Orion Festival: Tour Through the Never
programme.desc: Filmed at Orion Festival, Atlantic City, this concert film will give all fans a spectacular Live experience from start to finish. Classic Metallica featuring unforgettable version of their hits: 'One', 'Master Of Puppets', 'Sad But True' and more.

programme.title: Slipknot - Day of the Gusano
programme.desc: On December 8th 2015, after more than a decade of patiently waiting, the Mexican Maggots finally welcome the most anticipated visit of Slipknot and Knotfest to Mexico. The band did not disappoint. This show will leave you speechless and craving more.

programme.title: Scorpions - Forever And A Day: Live In Munich
programme.desc: After 50 years on stages all around the world, Germany's Scorpions decided it was time to embark on one last tour. This fully authorized documentary follows the hard rockers from their beginnings as young music fans to the present day.

programme.title: Green Day: Live at Fox Theater
programme.desc: Green Day performs from "21st Century Breakdown", at the Fox Theater in the band's hometown, Oakland, California.

programme.title: Red Hot Chili Peppers - Live at Tokyo Dome 2023
programme.desc: Red Hot Chili Peppers celebrate the return of John Frusciante, who performs in Japan with the band for the first time in 16 years in 2023!

programme.title: Leon Bridges -- Live in London 2015
programme.desc: American singer-songwriter Leon Bridges performs his top tracks at the Apple Music Festival in London in 2015.

programme.title: Seal - Live at Soundstage
programme.desc: Seal's one-of-a-kind soaring, husky baritone voice is perfect for any genre. He's delighted fans and earned critical acclaim while staying true to classic, honest songwriting in his remarkable two-decade career.

programme.title: Rodrigo y Gabriela - Live @ Garorock Festival 2014
programme.desc: The Mexican duet takes the stage at Garorock Festival, in July 2014.

programme.title: R.E.M. -- Live in Milan 2008
programme.desc: Filmed at Arena Civica, Milan, this concert film will give all fans a live experience from start to finish; R.E.M. performs unforgettable versions of their hits — "Losing My Religion", "Drive," "Man On the Moon" and many more.

programme.title: The 1975: Rock Am Ring 2019
programme.desc: Rock im Park is a music festival that takes place in Nuremberg, Germany, lasting three days; featuring: The 1975.

programme.title: Red Hot Chili Peppers - Live at Tokyo Dome 2023
programme.desc: Red Hot Chili Peppers celebrate the return of John Frusciante, who performs in Japan with the band for the first time in 16 years in 2023!

programme.title: Harry Nilsson - Who is Harry Nilsson (And Why is Everybody Talkin' About Him)?
programme.desc: In this definitive documentary on the Grammy® award winning music legend Harry Nilsson, friends, family and colleagues delve into the acclaimed singer-songwriter's music, creative process and personal demons.

programme.title: Lynyrd Skynyrd: Pronounced Leh-Nerd Skin-Nerd & Second Helping - Live From The Florida Theater
programme.desc: Earlier this year Lynyrd Skynyrd performed their first two studio albums, Pronounced 'Lĕh-'nérd 'Skin-'nérd and Second Helping, live in their entirety for the first time, at two specially staged concerts at the Florida Theatre in their home town of Jacksonville, Florida.

programme.title: The Police: Around the World
programme.desc: During 1977-1981, The Police went on a global tour which took them through more than a dozen countries, including many that most rock bands of the period would fail to reach.

programme.title: Electric Light Orchestra - Live at Wembley 1978
programme.desc: Captured live at London's Wembley Arena and directed by Mike Mansfield this space-age show will live forever in rock history as, quite literally, out of this world.

programme.title: Elvis & Madona
programme.desc: Elvis & Madona is a romantic comedy that deals with an unusual subject in a delicate and realistic way: a love story between young lesbian Elvis and a transvestite Madona. The story takes place in Copacabana, neighborhood in Rio de Janeiro. The screenplay comprehends a full array of human types and, by following the journey of both protagonists, illustrates the conflicts generated by the evolution of behavior and custom. It is a modern and agile picture, and its soundtrack will follow the latest musical trends. Nevertheless, it is essentially a love story, proving that love can exist in any situation.

programme.title: Hansan: Rising Dragon [English Dub]
programme.desc: In 1592, Admiral Yi Sun-sin uses the Turtle Ship to battle Japanese forces off Hansan Island. Epic naval clash ensues

programme.title: Manhole [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: In one neighborhood in Seoul, about 10 people disappeared without a trace over 6 months. As even the smallest clues remain as to where the missing people have gone and who took them, residents' anxiety grows. Meanwhile, unidentifiable hair and blood stains were found on the manhole cover! What on earth is happening inside the manhole that threatens our peaceful daily life?

programme.title: Rampant [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Returning from imprisonment, a prince and his fellow countrymen band together to battle bloodthirsty demons.

programme.title: The Getaway [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Three girls are abducted and taken to a remote island. They're held captive by three brothers raised in isolation by their grandmother. The girls are forced to become the brothers' mates and desperately attempt to escape their captors.

programme.title: HELTER SKELTER [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Top star Lilico undergoes multiple cosmetic surgeries to her entire body. As her surgeries show side effect.

programme.title: The White Storm 2: Drug Lords [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: There is an iron rule in the Ching Hing Gang: No drug dealing. The gang leader, Yu Nam, has two right-hand men. One chooses to live in the bright world, while one is in the black. 15 yeas later, what will happen when they reunion?

programme.title: The Goblin [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Doo-hyeon, who goes by the name the ''Goblin'', goes to prison for taking the fall for Yeong-min who killed their boss. Released after 10 years, Doo-hyeon had been living a normal life, until he found out Yeong-min had been taking advantage of his name. Yeong-min goes so far as to kidnap Doo-hyeon's daughter to keep his mouth shut. Enraged, Doo-hyeon seeks revenge and announces the return of the real ''Goblin''.

programme.title: Upstream [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Gao Zhilei's impulsive decision to become a stay-at-home husband leads to unforeseen challenges. As life takes a reverse turn, he's forced to face responsibilities as the family's breadwinner, ultimately finding himself and starting anew.

programme.title: Tazza: The Hidden Card [English Dub]
programme.desc: Dae-gil, a young man with natural born talents in gambling, makes a dazzling debut as a gambler and gets reunited with his first love, Mi-na. However, Dae-gil soon becomes the scapegoat of betrayal and conspiracy and is forced to be on the run. Dae-gil plans to get revenge and prepares for one big, fated game for Mi-na who has been helping him every step of the way.

programme.title: Escape from the 21st Century [English Dub]
programme.desc: The story follows three friends who discover they have the power to travel back and forth 20 years with a sneeze. However, the future is not as good as they hoped, and they need to take on the responsibility of saving the world.

programme.title: High Forces [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Distanced from his family after a car accident takes the sight of his daughter, a father must use his professional bodyguard training when a flight they're on is overtaken by armed hijackers. A taut puzzle of deception unravels when the hijackers' motivations are revealed and the father must rescue not only his daughter and wife, but all those aboard.

programme.title: River [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: On a calm winter’s day in Kibune, Kyoto, a mountain inn and its staff all find themselves trapped in a time loop.

programme.title: Railway Heroes [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: This gripping historical drama tells the true story of the Shanghai Rail Corps, a team of railroad workers turned secret resistance fighters during the Second Sino-Japanese war.

programme.title: You Will Die in 6 Hours [English Sub]
programme.desc: Jung-yoon was approached by a random stranger named Jun-woo, who told her she'd be dead in six hours. As she follows him for answers, she begins to question whether he's her savior or the one trying to put her in danger.

programme.title: HELTER SKELTER [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Top star Lilico undergoes multiple cosmetic surgeries to her entire body. As her surgeries show side effect.

programme.title: To Be Killed by A High School Girl [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: A man has an obsession that, if he is to die, it would be by being killed by a high school girl. With his strange obsession in mind, he decides to become a teacher.

programme.title: The Villainess [English Dub]
programme.desc: An assassin seeks revenge after secrets ruin her chance at freedom, unleashing her deadly skills in a bloody rampage.

programme.title: Airpocalypse [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Ma Le, a psychologist who calls himself a "suicide intervention master," makes money off the misfortunes of others. One day, a "birthday star" falls from the sky and hits Ma Le. Having accidentally inhaled divine energy, Ma Le is told that the world is on the verge of collapse and that only by gathering the four gods of wind, rain, thunder, and lightning, who have been banished to the mortal realm, can everything be changed. Thus, the gods and mortals embark on a hilarious, fantastical, and thrilling journey...

programme.title: Last Letter [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Attending a class reunion in place of her deceased sister, a woman reignites an unexpected romance.

programme.title: Once Upon A Time in Shanghai [English Dub]
programme.desc: A laborer moves to Shanghai in the hope of becoming rich. But ends up using his kung fu skills to survive. Remake of The Boxer From Shantung.

programme.title: IP MAN 1 [English Dub]
programme.desc: A semi-biographical account of Yip Man, the first martial arts master to teach the Chinese martial art of Wing Chun. The film focuses on events surrounding Ip that took place in the city of Foshan between the 1930s to 1940s during the Second Sino-Japanese War. Directed by Wilson Yip, the film stars Donnie Yen in the lead role, and features fight choreography by Sammo Hung.

programme.title: IP MAN 2 [English Dub]
programme.desc: Having defeated the best fighters of the Imperial Japanese army in occupied Shanghai, Ip Man and his family settle in post-war Hong Kong. Struggling to make a living, Master Ip opens a kung fu school to bring his celebrated art of Wing Chun to the troubled youth of Hong Kong. His growing reputation soon brings challenges from powerful enemies, including pre-eminent Hung Gar master, Hung Quan.

programme.title: IP MAN 3 [English Dub]
programme.desc: When a band of brutal gangsters led by a crooked property developer make a play to take over the city, Master Ip is forced to take a stand.

A taut puzzle of deception unravels when the hijackers' motivations are revealed and the father must rescue not only his daughter and wife, but all those aboard.

programme.title: Highlander: The Animated Series
programme.desc: A flashback shows the death of Connor MacLeod at Kortan's hand during the Jettator ceremony.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: When an Alliance raid on a Banshee clan permits the escape of Banshee renegade, Sh’lainn Blaze, the Alliance turns to professional bounty hunter Nick Logan for help. Logan’s investigation turns up questions about his own past life – even as the vengeful Banshee try to eliminate both Logan and his quarry.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: Rinaker wants Nick and Sh’lainn eliminated because he’s afraid they know too much about the Alliance. The renegade bounty hunter and Banshee track an Alliance airship to its secret Roswell base. Logan is ready to turn himself in to get some answers, but the Banshee grab Sh’lainn and Logan must turn to the Alliance for help with her rescue.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: On their first Alliance assignment, Nick and Sh’lainn are sent by Rinaker to the Himalayas to find a missing team of mountain climbers. They find the alien refugees – the Yeti – who are guarding a stolen Lycanthrope weapon powerful enough to destroy the planet. All are in danger, as the werewolves will stop at nothing to get the weapon back in their possession.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: In his relentless search to find out what truly happened to his biological father, Logan uncovers something he didn’t bargain for – an assassin android that marches right up to the Alliance’s front door looking for its preprogrammed target – Nick Logan!

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: When a team of allied intelligence agents learns that extraterrestrial beings have been living among humans for years, they vow to protect earth.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: Ruck, the werewolves pack leader, escapes from the Alliance and tracks down the EMP bomb which the Yeti race has been hiding. The doomsday device is accidentally activated while it’s being stolen, and Logan must discover its location before time runs out.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: An alien satellite that has been “watching” us for fifty years collides with a NASA shuttle. Rinaker doesn’t want its secrets exposed, so he sends Logan, Blaze, Trueblood and Ti-Yet on a stolen Lycanthrope ship to retrieve the data before anyone else. Logan hopes the information might reveal information about his father.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: Cattle mutilation draws Logan to a small town and saddles him with a new partner, Dr. Petrovic. They discover science has spawned more trouble – hybrid, mutant, alien fire ants. Now they must rescue the townsfolk and the Detail Team before Rinaker calls an air strike on the town.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: Mab, Queen of the Banshees, dispatches two bullheaded Minotauri bounty hunters and a cerberus parahound after the same prize – the head of Sh’lainn Blaze.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: A vampire that once worked for INTRAcom has mutated and is now staging attacks on his former boss’s holdings in an effort to protect the Brazilian rain forest. The creature rescues Logan, but Rinaker calls for an air strike on a lost Vampire city rather than risk its discovery by INTRAcom.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: Sh’lainn’s death vision predicts everyone at the Alliance base will die in twelve hours. What she doesn’t realize is that she will be the cause. After coming into contact with a recovered alien probe, she reverts to her wildest Banshee state and begins mutating the technology around her. Magical “earth stones” from the Banshee clan may be her only hope.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: Logan and Fitz are missing and presumed dead while on a mission to locate a downed alien ship in Haiti. They have been captured by a race of slug-like beings that can only inhabit the bodies of dead humans, which transforms them into zombies. Logan and Fitz are next and time is running out.

programme.title: Princess Play Time
programme.desc: The proud Princess likes to do things her own way, but her antics are always joined by her restless brother, Prince, who tends to turn everything topsy-turvy. Any playtime in their room transforms into a fantastic journey through unusual worlds: the children arrange a picnic on the Moon, conduct a detective investigation in a toy city, or search for pirate treasures on islands! Although initially, the Princess and Prince seem to clash and compete, by the end, they always find joy in each other's company and that of their cherished dog, Bona.

programme.title: Talking Tom and Friends
programme.desc: Things get even more epic in Season 3 as Talking Tom and Friends try new ways to make their dreams come true, making more friends (and enemies) along the way!

programme.title: Monster Town
programme.desc: Meet the Monster Trucks, a gang of colossal, hard-working cars who team up to help their friends and community in Monster City.

programme.title: Ollie! The Boy Who Became What He Ate
programme.desc: Ollie is a 6-year-old with a massive imagination, often lost in his own world - flipping, sliding, climbing and rocket-blasting through the house, practicing at being the master of all things. But even masters need to stop and refuel. When meals or snack time interrupt Ollie’s play, he finds himself confronted with the real challenge of childhood; trying new food. To escape his predicament, Ollie uses his magic spoon to transport himself, along with his sister Poppy, and her stuffy Nummy, to a food planet filled with adventure and the very food Ollie stuck his spoon into.

programme.title: The Fixies
programme.desc: The Fixies follows the comical misadventures of Tom Thomas and his secret friendship with Simka and Nolik, the children of the Fixie family that lives in his apartment. There’s just no end to the troubles Tom Thomas and his Fixie friends get themselves into with all the gadgets and appliances around them!

programme.title: Gummy Bear and Friends
programme.desc: Gummy lives in an apartment with his friend Harry the Chameleon, while his other friend Kala the Cat hangs out in a ninja dojo on the roof. Together they go on wild and wacky adventures in their building and hometown. Enjoy the fun and crazy adventures!

programme.title: Grojband
programme.desc: The story about 12 year old Corey that emotionally torments his sister so that she will write the ultimate lyrics for his garage band.

programme.title: Ebb and Flo
programme.desc: The world of Ebb and Flo is seen through Ebb’s eyes and Ebb reveals all the emotions grown-ups try to hide. Flo doesn’t think of Ebb as a dog, and Ebb doesn’t think of Flo as a small human, they just are the best of friends. Until Bird arrives to lovingly disrupt Ebb’s world. Ebb and Flo’s home is an old boat moored by the beach. Things Couldn’t Be Better!

programme.title: Tentacle 8
programme.desc: A mysterious computer virus wipes out highly classified personnel files at the NSA, prompting a top secret investigation. Raymond Berry, an NSA operative suspected of crimes against the United States, risks his life to uncover the truth.

programme.title: Susie's Hope
programme.desc: Based on a true story, the inspirational relationship between Donna Lawrence (Emmanuelle Vaguer) a pit bull attack survivor, and Susie (Susie Lawrence), an abused pit bull-mix puppy, as they learn to heal and forgive together.

programme.title: Like Sunday, Like Rain
programme.desc: Surrounded by wealth and living with abundant resources in Manhattan, 12-year-old cello prodigy Reggie, lives a solitary life lacking only frequently absent parents and friends. Estranged from family, having slacker boyfriend troubles, and fired from her waitressing job, sometimes musician 23-year-old Eleanor needs a new place to live and a new job.

programme.title: Watercolor Postcards
programme.desc: A small town girl with a troubled past returns home only to find that both her sister and her hometown are in peril. Only when she falls for a man who similarly has dark days behind him will they muster up the faith and love needed to save the things they hold dear in life.

programme.title: Walt Before Mickey
programme.desc: A young man named Walt Disney had big dreams, and no matter how many obstacles he had to face he never gave up--from his tumultuous childhood, to serving his country, to borrowing money, to the creation of his first iconic animated character Mickey Mouse.

programme.title: Camp Cool Kids
programme.desc: At their summer camp competition games, Spence and his big brother Zach find themselves on opposing teams: its the dweebs against the bullies. Can Spence make new friends, overcome his fears and find faith in himself, stand up to the bullies and win a trophy in the process?

programme.desc: Based on a true story, the inspirational relationship between Donna Lawrence (Emmanuelle Vaguer) a pit bull attack survivor, and Susie (Susie Lawrence), an abused pit bull-mix puppy, as they learn to heal and forgive together.

programme.title: Like Sunday, Like Rain
programme.desc: Surrounded by wealth and living with abundant resources in Manhattan, 12-year-old cello prodigy Reggie, lives a solitary life lacking only frequently absent parents and friends. Estranged from family, having slacker boyfriend troubles, and fired from her waitressing job, sometimes musician 23-year-old Eleanor needs a new place to live and a new job.

programme.title: Watercolor Postcards
programme.desc: A small town girl with a troubled past returns home only to find that both her sister and her hometown are in peril. Only when she falls for a man who similarly has dark days behind him will they muster up the faith and love needed to save the things they hold dear in life.

programme.title: Walt Before Mickey
programme.desc: A young man named Walt Disney had big dreams, and no matter how many obstacles he had to face he never gave up--from his tumultuous childhood, to serving his country, to borrowing money, to the creation of his first iconic animated character Mickey Mouse.

programme.title: Camp Cool Kids
programme.desc: At their summer camp competition games, Spence and his big brother Zach find themselves on opposing teams: its the dweebs against the bullies. Can Spence make new friends, overcome his fears and find faith in himself, stand up to the bullies and win a trophy in the process?

programme.title: Where Heavy Music Lives

programme.title: Metal That Rocks

programme.title: Night Time Metal

programme.title: Your Pulse Of Metal
programme.desc: Sync your heartbeat to the complex rhythms of the underground. This collection dives into technical mastery and hidden gems that push your adrenaline. If you’re ready to feel the music in your veins, we’ve got the tracks.

programme.title: For Metalheads Only
programme.desc: Leave the rock anthems at the door—this is 100% pure steel. We’ve dialed the distortion to eleven for a lineup strictly for the heavy-duty fans. No compromises, no fillers, just total sonic devastation.

programme.title: Heavy Pumping
programme.desc: Ditch the pre-workout and let the riffs do the heavy lifting. This high-octane blast of speed and power is designed to fuel your gains or ignite a living room mosh pit. High BPMs, crushing drums, and zero excuses.

programme.title: Night Time Metal

One of the best upgrades you can do is replacing the guide

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Nicole's Wooden Spatula
programme.desc: Nicole's favorite wooden spatula recently decided it had enough. The spoon was a layup from multiple pieces and featured two glue joints. With repeated exposure to moisture and heat, the joints eventually opened up. While the spatula is repairable, we decided we'd try to make something spatula as a fun collaborative project.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Shop Safety - Tablesaw Experience
programme.desc: Whenever I have a new student in the shop, I try to convey what if feels like when something is going wrong on the tablesaw. This may seem like an abstract idea, but knowing how to identify a problem before it goes too far could give you that extra second or two you need to prevent disaster.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: So I Changed My Mind!

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Invisible Panel Joints
programme.desc: The secrets to perfect panel glue-ups with invisible joints.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Jointer Setup
programme.desc: I find that the jointer is one of the most complex tools to calibrate. But if you ever used one that was out of shape, you know exactly why calibration is critical to your success. I hear from so many woodworkers who think their jointing problems are due to technique, when in reality, its the jointer itself that’s presenting the issues.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: David Marks Project in Progress
programme.desc: This is a quick tour of David Marks project in progress. David loves to make massive turned sculptures and his current project is a doozie! It’s a huge disc-shaped turned piece featuring a big marquetry image on the front. I hope you enjoy this as much as I did. It’s almost like an episode of Woodworks! Well, sort of.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: 10 Things I Wish I Knew When I Started Woodworking
programme.desc: Some tips that might save you some heartache, time and money.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Contemporary Clock
programme.desc: Here’s another great small project for the holidays. Its a small Contemporary Clock. This piece should take about two days to build. And this is another project that can benefit from the batching process. So be sure to make a bunch!

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Fixing a Knot
programme.desc: Ever find yourself short on material and that one board you really need has a nice open knot in it? You could always go out and buy more material, but sometimes its just easier and faster to stabilize and repair the knot. And instead of trying to hide the knot, sometimes its just better to embrace it, and make it look look resinous and natural.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Gadget Station Part 12
programme.desc: Well I finally made it to the finish line. This episode covers the hinge installation, pegging the tenons in the doors, making custom ebony handles, and finishing. I end the video with a justification of my design.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Marking Gauges
programme.desc: If you're not using marking gauges or some sort of blade to lay out your joinery, you are really missing out! I remember a conversation I had with William Ng at the William Ng School when he told me, "If you want to make good joinery, use a pencil. But if you want to make great joinery, using a knife!"

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: My First 3-Phase Tool!
programme.desc: My first 3-Phase tool requires some specialized gear to get it working.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Installing a Clear Vue CV1800 Cyclone
programme.desc: One of the most important safety upgrades you can make for your shop is good quality dust collection. If you run a bunch of power tools, it's hard to argue with the effectiveness of a ducted cyclone system. When I first moved into the new shop, the folks from Clear Vue came down to help me install a new CV1800 cyclone.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: No Fence Miter Station
programme.desc: A look at how I made my miter station and why there's no fence.

programme.desc: Nicole joins me for a new beginner series of projects starting with a handy blanket ladder.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Cheap Effective Chisel Sharpening
programme.desc: This is a simple method to get started sharpening without breaking the bank.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Criss-Cross Table
programme.desc: The base of this large table features a criss-cross design that does away with two of the aprons you'd find in a typical table base. I honestly wasn't sure if it would work and the only way to find out was to build one.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: I Made My Own Plantation Shutters
programme.desc: Making your own plantation shutters is actually pretty easy with the help fo Rockler.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Popping the Grain in Maple
programme.desc: Marc teaches how to pop out the pattern of grains, and in particular this Maple piece!

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Quick High-Quality Shop Cabinets
programme.desc: A new set of custom cabinets with oodles of storage!

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Make Stains Look Better! - DIY Blotch Prevention Formula
programme.desc: An easy to make DIY formula that works better than the stuff you can buy!

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Shop Journal #2
programme.desc: Now that the tools are in place, its time to start getting the place ready for some sawdust-slingin' action! I hope you enjoy this insider's look into my shop move.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Why Did My Cutting Board Split?
programme.desc: I don't know if this ever happens to you, but sometimes my tools just get out of whack and start to sound funny. Take a listen and let me know if you have any advice. Also have you ever wondered why end grain cutting boards are prone to splitting? Here's a couple of reasons why!

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Respirators in the Wood Shop aka Dust In Time
programme.desc: Here’s a quick review of the dust and fumes that can make our lives miserable in the shop, and why we need respirators for pro-active protection. And below you will find a links to the exact respirator setup I like to use: the 3m 7500 Series.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Repurposed Outdoor Coffee Table
programme.desc: An old table has a new life as a coffee table.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Coves on the Tablesaw & the Parallelogram Cove Jig
programme.desc: Many people are surprised when they find out they can make incredibly beautiful (and large) coves moldings on the tablesaw. I know I was! In this episode, I'll give you a rundown on the process for creating both symmetrical and asymmetrical coves.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Sculpted End Table Part 4
programme.desc: Time for the fun stuff! The legs are routed and then shaped by hand with a cabinet-maker’s rasp. I then show you how you can use card scrapers and sandpaper to achieve the smoothest finish possible. And finally, we will glue all the legs to the center pieces.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: 5 Tips for Laying Out Project Parts
programme.desc: Whenever I lay out my project parts in rough lumber, I find that there are 5 things that I always try to keep in mind.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Chiseling a Corner
programme.desc: I recently had to cut a large rabbet using a rabbeting bit which resulted in rounded corners. While this process may be common sense to some, the actual steps taken to achieve a perfect continuation of the rabbeted edge without mangling the integrity of the lines requires quite a bit of attention to detail. So this is a step by step review of my process.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: How to Make a Vacuum Bag aka A Pressing Matter
programme.desc: Marc teaches how to make your own vacuum bag for veneer press.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Wall-Hanging Magazine Rack
programme.desc: This video shows you how to build the Wall-Hanging Magazine Rack, designed by Glen Huey. And because I don't like to leave well enough alone, I'll also show you an alternative version of the magazine rack that employs a few of my personal design changes.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Advent Calendar Part 2
programme.desc: In the second part of this three-part series, I continue with the construction of the main grid-work. I show you a typical manner trick for cutting small dowel pieces and then the assembly begins.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Gadget Station Part 10
programme.desc: I cut and fit the door components. I also cut the mortise and tenon joinery for the rails and stiles. A stupid mistake causes a small injury and a bit of a setback, so the last part of the video is dedicated to fixing that mistake.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Shop Journal #1
programme.desc: As many of you know already, I am moving my shop back to the old space. I have some big changes in mind and this video gives you a good idea of what's to come. I plan on releasing a series of these short "Shop Journal" posts in true video blog fashion so you can keep up with the latest developments. I am really excited to get back into the old space and I hope you enjoy this inside look.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Cross-Cut Sled Slot Repair
programme.desc: One of the primary benefits of a cross-cut sled is the fact that the base provides zero-clearance, supporting the work through the entire cut and producing near tearout-free results. Over time, regular use can cause that slot to widen. Here's how you can fix it, without having to rebuild.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Waterborne Finishes & HVLP
programme.desc: Technically, this is really Part 4 of our Wall-Hanging Tool Chest build, but because I focused so strongly on waterborne finishes and HVLP (High Volume Low Pressure spraying), it received its own stand-alone title.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Hidden Wireless Charging in a Desk Top
programme.desc: Wireless charging is cool. Wireless charging that is completely hidden is even cooler! When I built my Executive Desk, I knew I wanted to include wireless charging as a feature but I didn't want to look at a charging pad all the time.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: I Bought a Sawstop! - First Impressions
programme.desc: I bought a SawStop. Hopefully I won't regret it.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Gaming Coffee Table
programme.desc: A coffee table to doubles as a gaming surface!

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Dream Shop Build
programme.desc: Every woodworker (I think!) dreams of someday being able to construct their own dedicated woodworking space. I hope the sharing of my personal experience with you will provide some ideas and inspiration for your own shop, regardless of its size.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Make a Kid Size Maui's Hook
programme.desc: Recently, my son has been obsessed with the Disney movie Moana. One of the primary characters is the demigod Maui who wields a magical hook. The hook has a very distinct look and is adorned with special carvings. Using a single 2×4, I made a kid-sized version of the hook.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Milling Lumber aka The Jointer's Jumpin'
programme.desc: Learn how to properly mill your lumber with Marc in this episode because you not gonna get far without it!

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Why the Jointer Can’t Do it All
programme.desc: Why the jointer can't be used to surface all sides of a board.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Power Carving with the Arbortech TURBOPlane
programme.desc: For me, power carving is one of the most challenging aspects of woodworking. It all started back in 2003 when I got hooked on David Marks' show, Woodworks. On several occasions, he would pull out a grinder and get all medieval on a beautiful piece of wood. The end result would be a beautifully sculpted creation that could only be called art.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Grasshopper Pull Toy
programme.desc: This fun little pull toy is easy to make. The great thing about it is you can get your child involved in the process at whatever level you're comfortable with. Older kids can cut and sand the parts. Younger kids can paint and assemble the grasshoppers.

programme.title: Guerra de Mujeres
programme.desc: Yubiri le dice a Briggite que quiere renunciar al trabajo y Briggite la invita a comer a un restaurante | con el fin de convencerla que no renuncie | porque ella la necesita para que le de ideas para las campañas publicitarias. En tanto Olegario y Ana conversan sobre lo sucedido entre ellos | aducen que fue un resbalón y hablan sobre Mauricio y Pastor | piensan que el comportamiento de ellos | es rarísimo. Mientras Pastor y la Secretaria están en la oficina hablando | él la invita a tomar café.

programme.title: Voltea pa' que te enamores
programme.desc: El día en la oficina se vuelve incómodo cuando Luis Fernando le pide a Dileidy que la acompañe a ver un terreno y Aureliano se pone celoso. Después, Santiago se ofrece para llevar a Matilde al hotel donde está Moncho y Gonzalo supone que es traicionado.

programme.title: Episodio 12
programme.desc: Moisés y Elizabeth se ven a escondidas, mientras Misael busca recuperar a su hija. Manuela ignora que no puede ser madre y Ricardo mantiene la mentira sobre su salud. Katiuska revela a Hortensia la doble vida de Ricardo con Celia para desestabilizar la unión. Celia, instigada por Katiuska, intenta hacerle daño a Manuela en la clínica manipulando su medicamento, pero es sorprendida por Ricardo en el acto. La tensión crece mientras las verdades y traiciones comienzan a salir a la luz.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: Eustoquio incendia la boutique siguiendo órdenes de Arminda contra Consuelo, atrapando a Rosa adentro. Rosa es rescatada inconsciente por los bomberos. Natalia, en plena disputa con Rosalía, revela que Alejandro es el novio de Rosa. Rosalía se siente humillada al saberse cambiada por una sirvienta. José Luis investiga la muerte de Carlos y descubre que Erasto fue el asesino del hermano de Rosa. Adolfo decide internar a Maricela en una clínica de desintoxicación. En el hospital, Blanca es atendida como desconocida sin familia.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: María Lucía sigue sin volver con su familia. Y, estando con Leo en una casa de campo, comienzan a pasar cosas entre ellos. A Trinidad le aterra esa relación, porque sospecha que María Lucía podría ser la hija de Miguel Ferrándiz. Virginia comienza a trabajar en la empresa. Pero las cosas se complican cuando se filtra en un correo electrónico el rumor de que Virginia mató a Miguel. Leonardo y Carlos Ernesto tratan de buscar al responsable. El capítulo finaliza cuando Trinidad, preocupada por la posibilidad de que su nieta sea pariente de Leo Ferrándiz, se acerca a la casa de Jimena para que puedan hablar del éste tema que les incumbe a ambas.

programme.title: Entre Tu Amor y Mi Amor
programme.desc: Sol consigue que Reina se doblegue ante ella. Reina está dispuesta a darle todo a cambio de que no siga buscando a su hija. Pero a Sol no le interesa todo el dinero que le ofrece Reina, sino Solamente verla sufrir y pagar por todo el daño que hizo. Más tarde, Eloy visita a Sol y juntos continúan elaborando el plan para sacarle todo el poder a Reina. Minutos después, la policía toca la puerta, ya que vienen a arrestar a Eloy por la posesión del arma usada en el crimen contra los Figueras.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: María Lucía sigue sin volver con su familia. Y, estando con Leo en una casa de campo, comienzan a pasar cosas entre ellos. A Trinidad le aterra esa relación, porque sospecha que María Lucía podría ser la hija de Miguel Ferrándiz. Virginia comienza a trabajar en la empresa. Pero las cosas se complican cuando se filtra en un correo electrónico el rumor de que Virginia mató a Miguel. Leonardo y Carlos Ernesto tratan de buscar al responsable. El capítulo finaliza cuando Trinidad, preocupada por la posibilidad de que su nieta sea pariente de Leo Ferrándiz, se acerca a la casa de Jimena para que puedan hablar del éste tema que les incumbe a ambas.

programme.title: Entre Tu Amor y Mi Amor
programme.desc: Sol consigue que Reina se doblegue ante ella. Reina está dispuesta a darle todo a cambio de que no siga buscando a su hija. Más tarde, Eloy visita a Sol y juntos continúan elaborando el plan para sacarle todo el poder a Reina. Minutos después, la policía toca la puerta, ya que vienen a arrestar a Eloy por la posesión del arma usada en el crimen contra los Figueras.

programme.desc: Eloy es detenido por la policía. Sol logra contactarse con un hombre que trabajó en un quiosco frente a donde Reina abandonó a su bebé.

programme.title: Guerra de Mujeres

Mientras Marcelo confronta a Celia, Moisés sospecha que su familia está detrás de su misterioso secuestro. programme.title: Blue Ridge
programme.desc: El ex Boina Verde, Justin Wise, cambia su vida de peligro por una placa de sheriff en un pueblo tranquilo en el corazón de las montañas Blue Ridge. Ahora más cerca de su ex esposa e hija, está listo para establecerse y abrazar una vida sin caos. Pero los problemas tienen una manera de seguirlo. Justo cuando comienza a adaptarse a la vida sencilla, un asesinato en la comunidad pone nerviosos a los residentes y reaviva una larga disputa entre dos de las familias más poderosas. A medida que Justin y sus ayudantes trabajan en el caso, se da cuenta de que hay más en su nuevo hogar de lo que parece. Los secretos se revelan y los motivos emergen, lo que lleva a Justin a una carrera contra el tiempo para resolver el caso antes de que la gente del pueblo tome la ley en sus propias manos.

programme.title: El Rastro

programme.desc: Brady le propone matrimonio a su exnovia, pero ella se entera de que él la engañó con su amiga; Dillon siente que debe confesar que le hizo una insinuación a la amiga de su prometida.

programme.title: Jerry Springer
programme.desc: Destiny confiesa una aventura; Kashe admite acostarse con la novia de su primo y estalla pelea; dos hombres compiten en un concurso de comida para conquistar a Amber.

programme.title: Jerry Springer
programme.desc: La amiga de Ariana quiere que deje a su novio por él; Samantha se declara en huelga porque teme que su novio la engañe.

programme.title: Jerry Springer
programme.desc: Las formas controladoras del novio de Morgan la han llevado a recurrir a su primo; Hannah hace todo lo posible para saber dónde está su novio; Ebony quiere que su novio dé un paso adelante y sea un ejemplo positivo para sus hijos.

programme.title: Jerry Springer
programme.desc: Paige desaprueba al novio de su hermana y diseña un plan para que lo deje; otra mujer puede frustrar los planes de Derek de hacer de su novia una parte permanente de su vida; Tony quiere a la novia de su primo.

programme.title: Séptimo Día
programme.desc: Las agencias de viajes se aprovechan de los clientes con ofertas de ensueño que se convierten en pesadillas.

programme.title: Séptimo Día
programme.desc: Una joven llena de sueños cae desde un séptimo piso en circunstancias extrañas. Una relación rota, secretos oscuros y una noche fatídica se entrelazan, mientras una familia busca respuestas y la verdad parece cada vez más elusiva.

programme.title: Séptimo Día
programme.desc: Carlos Ariel Torres, líder de una secta, estafó a sus seguidores con promesas de salvación apocalíptica y manipulación, llevándolos a vender bienes para comprar tierras en Ecuador. Actualmente, enfrenta varias denuncias por fraude.

programme.title: Séptimo Día
programme.desc: En Colombia, las muertes por accidentes viales por exceso de velocidad y embriaguez, siguen creciendo. A pesar de las tragedias, muchos conductores iresponsables quedan impunes, las leyes no logran frenar la creciente cifra de víctimas.

programme.title: Séptimo Día
programme.desc: En Cali, vecinos del barrio La Independencia tomaron justicia por mano propia tras el robo a Sara Ortega. Cansados de la impunidad, golpearon al ladrón, Jaime Barona López, con antecedentes desde 2002. La comunidad, frustrada por la inseguridad, busca soluciones ante la falta de acción judicial.

programme.title: Séptimo Día
programme.desc: Dos niños mueren luego de ser sedados para procedimientos dentales y las familias exigen respuestas.

programme.title: Séptimo Día
programme.desc: Juan José, de 7 años, falleció ahogado en una piscina sin salvavidas en Melgar. Deisy Riaño murió y su pareja quedó en estado vegetativo por inhalar monóxido de carbono en un glamping sin licencia en Manta. César Bolaños se ahogó en el Parque Tayrona, donde no había salvavidas. Las familias buscan justicia.

programme.title: Séptimo Día
programme.desc: Hogares convertidos en escenarios de violencia. Historias de arrendatarios que ocultan secretos, mientras familias vulnerables enfrentan tragedias impensables. En un país donde el arriendo es necesidad, la confianza se paga con vidas y silencio.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: Edenis Barrera Benavides, líder social y voluntaria de la Defensa Civil, fue brutalmente asesinada en 2014.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: En Calarcá, Quindío, las primas Luz Enith y Jenny Andrea Morales fueron halladas estranguladas en 2016. La investigación reveló que Jenny mantenía una relación con su ex esposo, Fabián Rendón, quien motivado por celos y venganza planeó el doble feminicidio junto a su cómplice Sebastián Muriel, administrador de un hotel local. Fabián confesó el crimen y señaló a Muriel como coautor.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: Julio Hermes formó una familia en Venadillo. Su hijo Jhon Andrés fue acusado de tener una relación incestuosa con su media hermana Angie Tatiana, quien quedó embarazada. En 2008, Angie desapareció y fue hallada muerta.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: En 2011, en Anzoátegui, Tolima, los gemelos Diego y Juan Sebastián, de 7 años, fueron secuestrados por Pedro Andrés Laserna, expareja de su madre Mariela, tras ella terminar la relación y denunciarlo por violencia. Laserna exigió dinero y su regreso a cambio de los niños, pero finalmente los asesinó. Fue condenado a 50 años de prisión por secuestro extorsivo agravado y homicidio agravado.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: En La Montañita, Caquetá, Jhon Jairo Marín rehace su vida con Yineth Mosquera, quien, celosa del hijo de su pareja, Esneider, termina atentando contra la vida del menor.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: En 2010, en Villavicencio, Meta, una granada estalló en la casa de la familia Prieto Valencia, matando a Isis Andrea, de solo 7 años, y herido a su hermano Marco Andrés. El principal sospechoso, Carlos Efraín Sánchez, expareja violenta de Estefany Prieto, huyó tras el ataque pero fue capturado en 2011. En 2013 fue condenado a 56 años de prisión por terrorismo, homicidio agravado y otros delitos.

programme.title: Juez Mom
programme.desc: Jennifer Lozada, de 46 años, demanda a su esposo y a su amante por enajenación de afecto.

programme.title: Los Informantes
programme.desc: Leonard Rentería, de 29 años, es la voz de Buenaventura, puerto golpeado por la violencia, el narcotráfico y la corrupción. Activista social, ha perdido amigos y recibido amenazas de muerte por defender a su comunidad. Su historia refleja el drama de una ciudad clave para Colombia, donde solo 37 de 117 acuerdos pactados tras el paro cívico de 2017 se han cumplido.

programme.title: Los Informantes
programme.desc: Fernando Araújo, exministro e ingeniero, fue secuestrado por las FARC en 2000 y mantenido cautivo durante 6 años en los Montes de María, soportando condiciones extremas. Escapó en 2006 tras un descuido de sus captores durante una operación militar. Perdió su matrimonio, pero recuperó su vida: dos meses después, el presidente Uribe lo nombró Ministro de Relaciones Exteriores.

programme.title: Los Informantes
programme.desc: En Colombia, el COVID-19 deja cientos de familias rotas. Andrea Peña perdió a sus padres y hermano en pocos días; Pilar Rivera se despidió de su esposo tras 28 años juntos; y Elvis Parra perdió a sus dos padres y dos hermanos en solo 15 días. Con más de 80 mil familias en duelo, el país enfrenta un dolor colectivo mientras urge el autocuidado y el distanciamiento.

programme.title: Maury
programme.desc: ¡Shatoria le sigue diciendo a D'Eric que él no es el padre del hijo de su hermana Latasha! ¡Luego, el exnovio de CiCi, Angel, le niega el bebé porque su mejor amigo Ralphie lo dice! ¡Los resultados te dejarán sin palabras!

programme.title: Maury
programme.desc: Tras una noche de pasión con su vecino, Lashanda afirma que Avery es el padre, ¡pero su novia no lo acepta! Además, Nikki necesita demostrar que nunca le ha sido infiel a Daniel o su relación con toda su familia estará en peligro.

programme.title: Maury
programme.desc: Rachelle cree que su novio, Chris, puede estar siendo infiel con unas 50 mujeres, ¡incluyendo a su hermana! Entonces, Carrie se sorprendió al descubrir que su novio, Chris, mintió sobre su servicio militar.

programme.title: Steve Wilkos
programme.desc: Un niño pequeño sufrió lesiones graves que pusieron en peligro su vida, pero no solo su madre, Jessica, es considerada sospechosa, sino que su novio, Major, y su abuela, Crystal, también están siendo investigados. ¡Descubre la impactante verdad hoy!

programme.title: Steve Wilkos
programme.desc: Chamira abandonó a su familia por la prostitución y envió a Latoya un video con menores. Emily recibió llamadas de que Kevin la engañaba y vendía drogas. ¿Qué revelará el detector de mentiras?

programme.title: Steve Wilkos
programme.desc: ¿Quién es responsable del bienestar del pequeño Noel? Todo el mundo puede negar las acusaciones, pero alguien sabe qué pasó, y Steve va a obtener explicaciones.

programme.title: Jerry Springer
programme.desc: ¡Amigos y familiares se niegan a aceptar el matrimonio entre personas del mismo sexo! Martin no quiere que su hijo se case con su novio. April quiere recuperar a su ex, ¡pero está enamorado de un hombre! ¿Quién tiene la última palabra?

programme.title: Jerry Springer
programme.desc: T-Jay dice que es hora de compartir su profundo y oscuro secreto con la mujer con la que ha estado saliendo; Natasha quiere casarse con el padre de su bebé, pero él es miserable en la relación; el novio de Sasha traicionó su confianza.

programme.title: Jerry Springer
programme.desc: Una mujer encuentra un romance con la hermana gemela de su prometido; un hombre recurre a otra mujer en busca de atención; un hombre le dice a la madre de su hijo que quiere estar con otra persona.

programme.title: Jerry Springer
programme.desc: ¡Es la batalla de los ex! Tony lucha para recuperar a su ex-amante. Richard le cuenta a su esposa que ha tenido un romance y ve a Lisa, su ex-amante, luchar por recuperarlo.

programme.title: Jerry Springer
programme.desc: Mike está listo para terminar su relación con su novia debido a sus celos; Jared admite un secreto; Barry espera demostrarle a una bailarina exótica que no es un cliente típico y quiere una oportunidad en el amor.

programme.title: Jerry Springer
programme.desc: Carl ha venido a decirle a su novia que se ha estado acostando con su peor enemiga, Keisha. A continuación, Donte le dirá a su mejor amigo, Quincy, que está acostándose con su prometida. Después, Janel y Nikkie están peleando por el mismo hombre.

programme.title: Jerry Springer
programme.desc: Briget quiere que cesen los rumores sobre las infidelidades de su novio; Samantha dice que su mejor amiga se ha convertido en su peor enemiga; Moniqua quiere sacar de escena a la nueva mamá del bebé de su ex novio.

programme.title: Jerry Springer
programme.desc: Destiny confronta a su amiga por invadir la propiedad de otras personas; una confesión de proporciones épicas podría ser un factor decisivo; un secreto oculto puede alterar los planes de una pareja.

programme.title: Jerry Springer
programme.desc: Joanne quiere tener un trío con su amiga y el novio de su amiga; la novia de Ron está increíblemente celosa por una razón; Jazmen confronta a su novio y a una mujer con la que ha estado enviando mensajes de texto sexuales.

programme.title: Séptimo Día
programme.desc: Los adolescentes luchan contra trastornos de salud mental que les hacen terminar prematuramente con sus vidas.

programme.title: Séptimo Día
programme.desc: Un hombre, múltiples crímenes. Jorge Ignacio Palma, condenado por el asesinato de tres mujeres y el intento de matar a otras seis, deja tras de sí un rastro de horror, preguntas sin respuesta y una madre que exige justicia y verdad.

programme.title: Séptimo Día
programme.desc: En 2018, Yeimy Ilias aceptó la propuesta de ser la señora fotogénica después de que a su hija le hicieron la oferta de ser niña Barranquilla.

programme.title: Séptimo Día
programme.desc: Los ataques de perros peligrosos a niños aumentan en Colombia. Aunque existen leyes, muchos dueños siguen sin responsabilizarse. Las víctimas enfrentan lesiones graves, y las autoridades luchan contra la impunidad, mientras los ataques continúan.

programme.title: Séptimo Día
programme.desc: La inseguridad en el transporte público colombiano es alarmante. Rocío Donado fue atacada en Transmilenio, Wilfrido Murcia asesinado en un bus SITP, y Erika Romero apuñalada en Bogotá. En Barranquilla, Dora Mendoza perdió a su hija en un robo. La falta de seguridad y la reincidencia de delincuentes agravan la situación.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje

programme.title: Belleza
programme.desc: Zhukov le dice a Andrei que el hijo de Anna es suyo. Andrei cree el rumor, lo que provoca que Anna termine la relación y aborte. Udalov asesina a Gushin, pero antes de morir, este logra decirle a Andrei el nombre de su asesino. Anna, al ver a Andrei consolando a Natasha, la hija de Gushin, piensa que él ya no la ama y, en un acto de desesperación, intenta suicidarse. Su mejor amiga, Masha, la lleva al hospital. En venganza contra Andrei, Anna acepta casarse con Maks, el médico que le salvó la vida. Mientras tanto, Udalov establece en Rusia un negocio de adopciones ilegales de niños extranjeros, con la ayuda de la directora del hospital materno-infantil, María Serguéievna.

programme.title: Belleza
programme.desc: Andrei se casa con Natasha, quien está feliz, ya que siempre ha estado enamorada de él. Mientras tanto, el negocio de Maks enfrenta problemas, pues un poderoso mafioso llamado *El Amo* le exige pagar sus deudas. Para salvar el negocio de su esposo, Anna se convierte en amante de *El Amo*. Andrei recibe la visita de su amigo Vadim, quien está en Moscú investigando a Udalov por tráfico de niños. Juntos, deciden atraparlo. Anna y Andrei se reencuentran y sus sentimientos renacen, pero Natasha queda embarazada y Andrei no se atreve a abandonarla. Después de discutir con Andrei, Anna toma un taxi, pero los pasajeros, unos adolescentes drogadictos, intentan abusar de ella. En la lucha, uno de ellos muere.

programme.title: Belleza
programme.desc: Maks se divorcia de Anna y, aprovechando su detención, la deja sin nada. Andrei intercede ante un alto funcionario (el padre del joven fallecido) para evitar que el caso de Anna avance, ya que ella es inocente. Anna es liberada. Vadim invita a Andrei a Moscú, donde abren una agencia de detectives. Natasha apoya la decisión de su esposo y lo acompaña, pero su matrimonio se deteriora, ya que Andrei no puede olvidar a Anna. En la estación de tren, Anna salva a un hombre de un intento de asesinato: es Udalov. *El Amo* había enviado a un sicario para matarlo por no compartir sus ganancias en el tráfico de niños.

programme.title: Belleza
programme.desc: Anna Koroleva es la primera belleza de la ciudad. Hace tiempo que se ha acostumbrado a la idea de que todo el mundo se interesa sólo por su aspecto. Está rodeada de flores y admiradores, muchos pretendientes. El bandido local Zhukov tampoco pudo resistirse a ella, pero Anna se mantiene inaccesible: no le gusta Zhukov. Contrata a unos matones para que den una lección de venganza a la terca belleza. Un transeúnte, Andrei Savin, es testigo del ataque y defiende a la chica. Inesperadamente, Anna se enamora de Andrei. Al enterarse de la aventura de Anna, Zhukov se enfurece. Al descubrir que su antigua amante está embarazada, le dice a Andrei que el bebé es supuestamente suyo, de Zhukov. Andrei intenta averiguar la verdad, pero Anna, ofendida por su desconfianza, declara que efectivamente está embarazada del bandido. Andrei la deja, Anna aborta. Si hubiera podido adivinar a dónde la llevaría su orgullo...

Anna, al ver a Andrei consolando a Natasha, la hija de Gushin, piensa que él ya no la ama y, en un acto de desesperación, intenta suicidarse. Su mejor amiga, Masha, la lleva al hospital. En venganza contra Andrei, Anna acepta casarse con Maks, el médico que le salvó la vida. Mientras tanto, Udalov establece en Rusia un negocio de adopciones ilegales de niños extranjeros, con la ayuda de la directora del hospital materno-infantil, María Serguéievna.

programme.title: Belleza
programme.desc: Andrei se casa con Natasha, quien está feliz, ya que siempre ha estado enamorada de él. Mientras tanto, el negocio de Maks enfrenta problemas, pues un poderoso mafioso llamado *El Amo* le exige pagar sus deudas. Para salvar el negocio de su esposo, Anna se convierte en amante de *El Amo*. Andrei recibe la visita de su amigo Vadim, quien está en Moscú investigando a Udalov por tráfico de niños. Juntos, deciden atraparlo. Anna y Andrei se reencuentran y sus sentimientos renacen, pero Natasha queda embarazada y Andrei no se atreve a abandonarla. Después de discutir con Andrei, Anna toma un taxi, pero los pasajeros, unos adolescentes drogadictos, intentan abusar de ella. En la lucha, uno de ellos muere.

programme.title: Belleza
programme.desc: Maks se divorcia de Anna y, aprovechando su detención, la deja sin nada. Andrei intercede ante un alto funcionario (el padre del joven fallecido) para evitar que el caso de Anna avance, ya que ella es inocente. Anna es liberada. Vadim invita a Andrei a Moscú, donde abren una agencia de detectives. Natasha apoya la decisión de su esposo y lo acompaña, pero su matrimonio se deteriora, ya que Andrei no puede olvidar a Anna. En la estación de tren, Anna salva a un hombre de un intento de asesinato: es Udalov. *El Amo* había enviado a un sicario para matarlo por no compartir sus ganancias en el tráfico de niños.

programme.title: Belleza
programme.desc: Agradecido por haberle salvado la vida, Udalov lleva a Anna a Europa, donde ella comienza a ayudarlo en su negocio, sin saber que las adopciones son ilegales. Mientras tanto, en Moscú, la periodista Aline le muestra a Vadim y Andrei un video de su programa de televisión, donde una mujer llamada Olga revela que Udalov la mantuvo prisionera cuando intentó retractarse de entregar a su bebé en adopción. Udalov envía a Anna a Moscú por otro niño, pero esta vez el bebé está destinado a tráfico de órganos. En Moscú, El Amo secuestra a Anna para obligarla a revelar el paradero de Udalov.

programme.title: Belleza
programme.desc: Anna logra escapar. Udalov, al enterarse de que Anna no recogió al niño del orfanato, viaja apresuradamente a Moscú. Temiendo por su seguridad, decide quedarse en la ciudad y le compra a Anna una clínica de cirugía plástica. Anna se sumerge en su trabajo y es feliz. Mientras tanto, la policía se acerca cada vez más a Udalov. Anna le confiesa su amor por Andrei y le pide que lo localice. Sin querer perder a su "Galatea", Udalov le miente a Anna, diciéndole que Andrei ha muerto.

programme.title: Belleza
programme.desc: El amor entre Anna y Andrei renace y pasan la noche juntos. Sin embargo, Vadim llama desesperado a Andrei para informarle que su hijo, Pavlik, está gravemente enfermo. Anna también va al hospital a verlo, pero Andrei, molesto, le exige que se vaya. Anna se siente herida. Aline le revela a Anna que Udalov es un criminal, pero ella se niega a creerlo, ya que le ha dado una nueva vida y educación. Mientras tanto, Udalov intenta asesinar a El Amo. Anna le cuenta a Udalov que Andrei tiene un video con el testimonio de Alexandra, una mujer que trabajó para Udalov en Europa y sabe demasiado sobre sus negocios ilegales. Udalov entra en pánico y empieza a borrar cualquier evidencia en su contra. Vadim llama a Andrei con una noticia terrible: ha ocurrido una tragedia en la agencia de detectives…

programme.title: Belleza
programme.desc: Una explosión destruye la agencia y todos sus documentos. Anna empieza a darse cuenta de quién es realmente Udalov. Este, viendo que la situación se vuelve insostenible, decide huir a Europa. Le propone un trato a Anna: ella le hace una cirugía para cambiar su identidad, y a cambio, él ordenará la muerte de Natasha, la esposa de Andrei. Anna acepta. La operación es un éxito. Más tarde, Udalov llama a Anna y le dice que Natasha morirá en una hora. En ese momento, Anna se da cuenta del terrible error que ha cometido e intenta advertir a Andrei, pero llega tarde: el sicario mata a Natasha y también a Andrei, quien intentaba protegerla. Destrozada, Anna entrega a Udalov a la policía, ya que es la única que sabe cómo luce ahora. Regresa a su ciudad natal y decide comenzar una nueva vida. Con el corazón roto, pero con un propósito, adopta a Pavlik, el hijo de Andrei, para criarlo como suyo.

programme.title: Mi alma gemela
programme.desc: ¿Cuál es la mejor opción? ¿Un refugio familiar tranquilo o un romance apasionado? ¿Una esposa, con la que ha vivido durante décadas, o una joven amante? Después de pensarlo mucho, el protagonista de la película, Alexei, de 40 años, opta por rehacer su vida...

programme.title: Mi alma gemela
programme.desc: Alexei confiesa su infidelidad y deja a Vera. Se casa con Marina, pero pronto conoce a otra mujer, Varvara, con quien siente una conexión profunda.

programme.title: Mi alma gemela
programme.desc: Alexei busca a Varvara y se enamora de ella. Marina descubre su romance y le envía fotos comprometedoras, desatando una crisis.

programme.title: Mi alma gemela
programme.desc: Marina exige el divorcio. Alexei encuentra en casa de Varvara objetos de su antiguo hogar con Vera y descubre una impactante verdad.

programme.title: La mesa caliente
programme.desc: Un equipo de mujeres audaces y empoderadas debate desde diversas perspectivas sobre el entretenimiento y los temas más candentes y controversiales que afectan a la comunidad latina en Estados Unidos.

programme.title: Al rojo vivo
programme.desc: La revista noticiosa que define la agenda de la televisión en español en EE. UU. Se caracteriza por ofrecer, antes que nadie, historias que cautivan al público hispano y por presentarlas en un formato innovador que resalta el aspecto humano.

programme.title: Historias de las ciudades
programme.desc: A través de relatos únicos, el programa explora la historia, cultura y esencia de cada ciudad anfitriona, mostrando lo que las hace especiales más allá del fútbol. Desde sus tradiciones y gastronomía hasta sus íconos culturales y su conexión con el deporte, cada episodio ofrece una mirada profunda a los escenarios que recibirán a millones de aficionados.

programme.title: Operación Triunfo Estados Unidos
programme.desc: Jóvenes cantantes compiten para ganar la carrera musical que cambiará sus vidas.

programme.title: ARV: Archivo oculto
